summary: "The Tale of Scrotie McBoogerballs" is the second episode of the fourteenth season of the animated series "South Park" and the 197th overall episode. It first aired on Comedy Central in the United States on March 24, 2010. In the episode, Kyle, Stan, Kenny, and Cartman write a vulgar book intended to get it banned, but when Stan's parents find the manuscript the boys blame Butters, and they become enraged when the book is hailed as a literary masterpiece.
one_line: A 2010 South Park episode in which the boys write a vulgar book to get it banned, then turn on Butters when it is praised as literature.
